description: This file defines a serializer/deserializer (codec) for the SiloAddress class in Orleans, specifically providing methods to write and read SiloAddress instances to/from a binary wire protocol, with support for reference tracking and optional fields.

classes.name: SiloAddressCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for SiloAddress, responsible for serializing and deserializing SiloAddress objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress instance to the provided writer, handling null references, optional port and generation fields, and object start/end markers.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SiloAddress instance from the provided reader, reading address, port, and generation fields based on wire type and field headers.
